verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at help.thoropass.com (HTTP 200) with a structured index of help-center articles. Help articles are also served as Markdown (.md URLs), giving agents clean, agent-readable docs, and there is an MCP server connection guide. missing for 10: no llms-full.txt or first-party guidance on using these docs with agents, coverage limited to the help center (no agent-oriented API/developer docs evidenced), no independent corroboration of agent usage.
